title: Het hinniken van een paard - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid
author: Beeld en Geluid
changes: Trimmed to 20.85–23.25 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 120 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 120 Hz because the original carries 50 Hz mains hum.
